meta.title: OpenFilm Video Workshop
meta.description: OpenFilm AI video making, built specifically for DeepSeek Harness. The agent writes films as film.html; an embedded Studio in the sidebar gives live preview and hand editing; MP4 is rendered locally with ffmpeg. DSH-native extras: openfilm tools with canvas pointing, render jobs in the DSH task panel, tool call cards in chat, and a sidechat that accepts screenshots and voice. Requires the openfilm command (npm i -g openfilm) and ffmpeg on this machine.
